title: A closed subspace of a sober space is sober
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space which is sober: every irreducible closed subset of $X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] has a unique generic point. Let $E\subseteq X$ be a closed subset. Then $E$ with the induced topology is sober: every irreducible closed subset $Z\subseteq E$ has a unique point $\eta\in Z$ whose closure in $E$ is $Z$.
